[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Range Sum Query – Mutable** [LC 307 · Range Sum Query - Mutable](https://leetcode.com/problems/range-sum-query-mutable/){difficulty="Medium"}

The prefix-sum table gives $O(1)$ range sums but $O(n)$ per `update` — and here updates and queries are interleaved, so the table is rebuilt constantly and the whole run is $O(nq)$. Cut the array into $\sqrt n$ blocks and keep only each block's sum: an `update` rewrites one block's sum in $O(\sqrt n)$, a `sumRange` adds whole-block sums across the middle and walks the two $\le 2B$ edges by hand — $O(\sqrt n)$ each. $3\cdot10^{4}$ operations at $\sqrt{3\cdot10^{4}} \approx 173$ per op is trivially inside the limit. This is @sec-sqrt-a1's `SqrtBlocks` with the minimum, maximum summaries dropped.

[Solved in full in @sec-sqrt-p1-mutable.]{.card-link}
